value.rationale: The reflection count is the direct amount of geometric collision recursion in confined stochastic numerical integration. It has a sharp universal power-three tail and an infinite third moment despite rare multi-collision events and finite expected extra work. Explicit coefficients for all ball dimensions and the exact three-dimensional special case give useful workload and event-cap benchmarks; the flat Gaussian interval shows a different tail mechanism. No broad solver-performance theorem is claimed.
